summary.note: First forecasts graded on 2026-09-07: rare-earth non-relaxation forecast CORRECT (confirmed by China's June 2026 entity-list targeting of MP Materials/USA Rare Earth); Ukraine strike-pause forecast PARTIAL (pause gave way to a different, category-bounded 30-day energy-infrastructure commitment rather than a simple lapse).

forecasts.forecast: The CMMC 60-day review will conclude with a reformed-but-intact program and a reset phased timeline (not a repeal).
forecasts.note: Tracked on the CMMC Implementation thread; DoW CIO internal determination now targeted ~13 Sep 2026, under a week away.

forecasts.forecast: Golden Dome award tempo will accelerate through late 2026 into early 2027.
forecasts.note: No new award data this cycle (holiday-affected publication window); pre-year-end SBI test remains the key milestone to watch.

forecasts.forecast: The Kyiv-Moscow long-range-strike pause will lapse at term absent a broader framework.
forecasts.note: Rather than a simple lapse, a 7 Sep Trump-Putin call produced a different, narrower, category-bounded 30-day energy-infrastructure strike-halt commitment (contingent on Ukrainian reciprocity) - neither a clean lapse nor a comprehensive framework.

forecasts.forecast: China will not materially relax rare-earth/magnet controls on military-affiliated firms in the near term.
forecasts.note: Confirmed and extended: June 2026 entity-list action specifically targets MP Materials and USA Rare Earth, showing continued tightening rather than relaxation.

forecasts.forecast: Iran will follow through on its threatened 'faster, heavier, more painful' response with at least one further strike on a U.S.-linked or U.S.-flagged vessel or asset within 30 days.
forecasts.note: Tracked on the U.S.-Iran Conflict / Strait of Hormuz thread.

forecasts.forecast: The reported 30-day Ukraine energy-infrastructure strike-halt commitment will not hold cleanly for its full term without at least one contested violation claim from either side.
forecasts.note: Tracked on the Ukraine Ceasefire Diplomacy thread.

forecasts.forecast: External power will be restored to the Zaporizhzhia plant (or sufficient diesel resupply will occur) before onsite fuel is exhausted, avoiding a station blackout.
forecasts.note: Tracked in the STRATEGIC INTELLIGENCE section; both sides have incentive to avoid a blackout incident.

forecasts.forecast: The DoW CIO's internal CMMC Reform Task Force determination (~13 Sep) will recommend resuming assessment scaling on a revised timeline rather than a further indefinite pause or repeal.
forecasts.note: Narrower, near-term restatement of the CMMC forecast tied to the imminent ~13 Sep internal deadline.
